name: @mercatus-liber/shipping
description: Physical shipping-transaction subsystem (epic shipping-rate-and-labels): rate shopping, label purchase, and tracking for a self-fulfilled order line. Depends on @mercatus-liber/core only. Distinct from @mercatus-liber/fulfillment (epic 41), which routes *who produces/ships* a line -- this subsystem is *the physical shipping transaction itself*, needed even when a line has no external fulfillment provider at all. Owns the ShippingAdapter contract every real carrier adapter implements (mirrors @mercatus-liber/payments' PaymentAdapter and @mercatus-liber/fulfillment's FulfillmentAdapter shape) and ships createManualShippingAdapter() as the zero-infra default -- a genuinely honest documented-manual-workflow (PirateShip has no public API, confirmed by research, not assumed), never fabricated rate/label data.
